We cut our weekly reporting from four hours to twenty minutes.

The trick was not a new tool. It was deciding which three numbers the team actually reads, and dropping the other nineteen.

What would you drop first?
We cut weekly reporting from 4 hours to 20 minutes by deciding which 3 numbers the team reads and dropping the rest. Write-up: https://blog.example.com/three-numbers
